name: bld3_pisano_fib_div_fib_tendsto_zero
statement: : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (p3_pisano (Nat.fib n) : ℝ) / (Nat.fib n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
closed: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (p3_pisano (Nat.fib n) : ℝ) / (Nat.fib n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_pisano_fib_dvd_four_mul: the Pisano period of fib n divides 4n so is at most 4n, while fib n grows at least like n^2 (e.g. fib (n+2) ≥ n^2/4 or exponentially), so the ratio is squeezed to 0; strengthens the liminf statement p3_cor1.
